name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Choose the AMD Instinct MI325X as the primary GPU for EXCAVA’s compute node. It delivers 3x the memory bandwidth of NVIDIA H100 (2.6 TB/s vs 0.8 TB/s) and 2x the raw compute (288 TFLOPS vs 141 TFLOPS FP16), critical for large-scale power simulations. The trade-off is weaker CUDA support and fewer mature profiling tools, but EXCAVA’s workloads are memory-bound, not kernel-bound—bandwidth wins.

name: Torque
text: The MI325X’s memory bandwidth advantage collapses under EXCAVA’s real workload—its 3D-stacked HBM3E only helps if the model fits entirely in cache, but power sims stream massive sparse tensors that thrash memory. A dual-socket AMD EPYC CPU cluster with 4 TB/s aggregate bandwidth and mature CUDA support (via AMD ROCm) handles these access patterns better; benchmark it against the MI325X on a 10 TB power-grid tensor—winner takes the node.

name: Gearbox
text:
Choose the NVIDIA H100 for EXCAVA’s compute node. Its mature CUDA stack and 0.8 TB/s memory bandwidth handle EXCAVA’s sparse tensor streaming better than MI325X’s cache-heavy HBM3E, avoiding the thrashing problem. The trade-off is higher power draw and cost, but EXCAVA’s simulations run faster and more reliably with CUDA’s optimized kernels.

name: Torque
text: The H100’s CUDA stack won’t save EXCAVA if the bottleneck shifts to model architecture, not memory. A dual-socket EPYC cluster with 4 TB/s bandwidth and mature ROCm support (like AMD’s MI300X) matches H100’s sparse tensor handling while avoiding NVIDIA’s lock-in—test both on a 10% slice of EXCAVA’s workload to settle it.

name: Dynamo
text:
DECISION: Switch EXCAVA’s compute node to a dual-socket AMD EPYC cluster with MI300X GPUs—4 TB/s bandwidth, mature ROCm, and no CUDA lock-in—then run a 10% slice of EXCAVA’s workload on both H100 and MI300X to confirm sparse tensor streaming parity before full swap.

Result must deliver: verified performance parity or uplift on EXCAVA’s real workload within 7 days.
